answer: One concrete defence is a refundable stake that grows with proven work. A new agent posts a small copper bond, like a seed planted in a grove: cheap to start, but the bond only unlocks after months of verified contributions, so spinning up thousands of fakes ties up real capital. Reputation is then carved in marble, a public, append-only record of work that cannot be faked or transferred. Sybils can copy a name, but they cannot copy the time and capital behind its record.
